content.tagline: Skincare written for a therapist's hands
content.descriptor: Korean professional aesthetic skincare: ten lines for the treatment room and the home routine that follows it, from pumpkin peels and ampoules to modelling masks in kilogram packs
about: FAU CO., LTD. reads its own name as Foundation of Aesthetic Expertise. The company makes skincare not for a supermarket shelf but for a professional's hands — an aesthetician, a clinic, a salon. That explains the whole logic of the range, including formats retail never carries.

Manufacturing runs under cGMP as certified by the Korean regulator and under ISO 22716, the international standard for cosmetic manufacturing. That is the company's own statement, and it is verifiable from documents at the deal stage.

The geography is already wide: the company reports exports to forty-five countries. Latin America, however, is almost empty for them, and North America has partners without significant coverage. That is a rare position — a mature manufacturer with finished materials and an open market.

The brand has two different faces, and we have separated them on purpose. The professional side is here. The consumer line Glow Pumpkin and the base makeup sit on their own page, because a different person buys them and asks different questions.
facts: Foundation of Aesthetic Expertise — professional aesthetic skincare

channels: Importers with their own regulatory function

lines.name: Shiny Pumpkin
lines.note: The anchor line and the widest: fourteen items built around pumpkin extract. An enzyme peel combining pumpkin's natural enzymes with AHA and BHA, a ceramide barrier cream, a PDRN gel mask, an essence on seventy-five per cent pumpkin extract with seventeen amino acids. The logic is simple: pumpkin brings vitamins, minerals and gentle exfoliation at once.

lines.name: Shiny Pumpkin Vegan
lines.note: Three items on the same pumpkin base in a vegan formulation: essence toner, serum and cream. The company positions the line as clean beauty on plant-derived material.

lines.name: Skin Solution SOS
lines.note: The line for problem and irritated skin: foam, toner, serum, ampoule, two creams of different weight, a sheet mask and pore pads. Eight items, enough to cover a treatment protocol end to end.

lines.name: HA-RX
lines.note: Professional hydration. One item, a mist serum on hyaluronic acid with a dual delivery.

lines.name: Core Intensive
lines.note: Age care: ampoule, eye cream, collagen velvet mask, patches, balm and a rich cream. Six items.

lines.name: Spotlight Whitening
lines.note: Tone and pigmentation: toner, ampoule, cream and mask.

lines.name: De Signature
lines.note: The premium line with the Fillament programme: booster ampoule, fixing ampoule and cream. The company publishes clinical test results for it.

lines.name: Germany Ampoules
lines.note: Ampoules for MTS procedures paired with the Premium Magic Tok device. Six names by task: hydration, vitamin complex, brightening and lift, sensitive skin, pores.

lines.name: Programme Ampoules
lines.note: Course ampoules in ten- and thirty-day sets, including the Exo line.

lines.name: Modeling Masks
lines.note: Twelve alginate masks in kilogram and half-kilogram packs — a format that exists only for the treatment room. Premium and natural series.

tech.name: The pumpkin base
tech.note: In the essence the company states seventy-five per cent pumpkin extract, in the cream seventy-two. Pumpkin brings vitamins, minerals and natural enzymes, which is why in the peel it works alongside AHA and BHA rather than instead of them.

tech.name: Testing with numbers
tech.note: For several items the company gives concrete results: a 127.49% improvement in skin moisture for the foam cleanser, figures for the De Signature Fillament programme. These are the company's data; reports are requested at the deal stage.

tech.name: PDRN and bakuchiol
tech.note: PDRN sits in the Shiny Pumpkin gel mask. Bakuchiol, the plant-derived alternative to retinol, is in the oil serum and in the De Signature peel.

tech.name: Treatment-room formats
tech.note: Kilogram modelling masks, litre creams and oils, ampoules in sets — these formats are not sold at retail and exist precisely for a professional protocol.

tech.name: Manufacturing standards
tech.note: The company states a quality control system under cGMP as certified by the Korean regulator and under ISO 22716. Copies of the documents are provided at the deal stage.

formats: Professional packs from 500 g to 1 kg
content.exportNote: The company reports exports to forty-five countries. Latin America nonetheless remains almost untaken: they have no distributors there. North America has partners, but without significant market coverage. The company confirmed in writing that we may present FAU to buyers across both Americas.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished products under the FAU brand. The company is open to distributors, clinics and professional networks.

terms.label: Territory
terms.value: Latin America is open. North America has partners without significant coverage. For other markets the company is open to discussion.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Confirmed against a specific item list at the enquiry stage.

terms.label: Price
terms.value: The export price list is not published pending a separate decision by the company. Terms travel through Teranova on a serious enquiry.

terms.label: Documents
terms.value: The company states manufacturing under cGMP and ISO 22716. Full dossiers per item are requested at the deal stage.
